notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (support automation) evaluating Redwood starting Hosted API for fast rollout; likely to convert to Dedicated after POC if latency and price meet targets.

Key contact: Maria Velasquez (CTO) – quote: "We need <50ms tail latencies for agent response pieces, streaming feels make-or-break." Wants streaming + reliable tool calling (calendar, ticketing integration).

Security / Compliance notes: SOC2 mandatory for procurement; SSO/SAML integration required before production; asking for explicit audit logs and KMS integration. Primary ask: PII redaction for hosted logs (remove or hash email, phone, credit-card-like strings) and ability to toggle retention window. They want retention <= 30 days for session logs by default and option for >30 days under contract with controls.

POC scope: run 2-week Hosted API pass with synthetic and live traffic for chat agent flows, enable streaming to web client, test tool call flows to a mocked ticketing API, verify token latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) and measure cost. Team will provide 10 representative prompt templates and 3 tool-call adapters.

Business case: current NRR expansion horizon — plan to include LLM assistant in paid tier; target ARR uplift depends on cost per 1k tokens. Estimated initial commit if successful: $50k-$150k ARR with Dedicated later.

Pricing sensitivity: mid-market procurement; needs predictable committed pricing to justify migration to Dedicated. Negotiable on length of commitment (12–24 months).

Technical constraints: customer uses multi-region deployment (NA + EU), requires data residency for EU customers. Wants fallback routing — Hosted -> Dedicated -> smaller cheaper open model as last resort.

Open items: Can Redwood provide a canned PII redaction pipeline for hosted logs? How does Stripe/PCI-style token patterns detection work out-of-box? Need explicit confirmation from security on cryptographic controls around KMS.

Stated blockers: 
- Security team must approve hosted logging and retention model.
- Engineering will sign off after sustained p95 < 100ms on streaming token emission and tool calls >=99% reliability.

Assigned: AE Jordan Reyes; SE Rohit Malhotra.

Quote from Maria after demo: "Streaming response feel and tool reliability = retention or churn for us. If Redwood can show consistent tail latency and redact PII in hosted logs, we'll move fast."
implementation_notes: They will provide 3 integration points for tool-calling (tickets, calendar, billing); prefer HTTP webhook adapters. POC infra to be instrumented with trace ids provided by Redwood; request for per-token latency breakdown in dashboard.
procurement_notes: Legal: data residency + retention clauses required. Finance: needs committed pricing model and sample invoice. Procurement timeline: internal vendor review expected by 2026-04-10.
